stories.title: L’Aude et les Pyrénées-Orientales en vigilance orange pluie et inondations dimanche

en.title: Aude and Pyrénées-Orientales on orange alert for rain and flooding Sunday
en.summary: Météo-France forecasts heavy rainfall in two French departments, with up to 80 millimeters expected within hours and potential accumulations reaching 150 to 180 millimeters throughout the day.

stories.title: L'Aude passe en vigilance orange aux pluies et aux inondations dès demain, 6 heures, en plus des Pyrénées-Orientales, annonce Météo-France

en.title: Aude moves to orange alert for rain and flooding starting tomorrow at 6 a.m., alongside Pyrénées-Orientales, announces Météo-France
en.summary: Aude enters orange alert status for precipitation and flood risk beginning tomorrow morning, while Hérault was downgraded from orange to yellow alert status.

stories.title: Multilatéralisme ou Trumpisme ? Lula ou Bolsonaro ? À l’heure de l’élection présidentielle, le Brésil à la croisée des chemins

en.title: Multilateralism or Trumpism? Lula or Bolsonaro? At the time of the presidential election, Brazil at a crossroads
en.summary: Brazil's two main presidential candidates, with the first round of voting scheduled for Sunday, represent opposing visions of diplomatic approach and international relations.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Marine Le Pen réaffirme sa confiance en Jordan Bardella malgré les accusations d’antisémitisme révélées par « Mediapart »

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Marine Le Pen reaffirms her confidence in Jordan Bardella despite antisemitism accusations revealed by "Mediapart"
en.summary: The National Rally's presidential candidate responded for the first time following Mediapart's publication of new evidence regarding antisemitic messages attributed to Jordan Bardella, who continues to deny authorship.

stories.title: Propos antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : Marine Le Pen maintient «totalement» sa «confiance» au président du RN

en.title: Antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella: Marine Le Pen maintains "totally" her "confidence" in the RN president
en.summary: Marine Le Pen expressed full confidence in Jordan Bardella two days after Mediapart published authentication elements of antisemitic messages attributed to him.

stories.title: Marine Le Pen maintient "totalement" sa "confiance" à Jordan Bardella, à qui Mediapart attribue des écrits antisémites

en.title: Marine Le Pen maintains "total" "confidence" in Jordan Bardella, to whom Mediapart attributes antisemitic writings
en.summary: Marine Le Pen publicly expressed unwavering confidence in Jordan Bardella following Mediapart's publication of authentication evidence for antisemitic messages attributed to him.

stories.title: Exécution ratée de Christa Pike : le chef de l'administration pénitentiaire du Tennessee démissionne

en.title: Failed execution of Christa Pike: Tennessee prison administration chief resigns
en.summary: Tennessee's prison administration director resigned after a failed execution of Christa Pike, who survived two lethal injections on Wednesday and remains hospitalized in critical condition.

stories.title: Droit au logement en Espagne : des manifestations monstres dans tout le pays ce samedi

en.title: Right to housing in Spain: massive demonstrations across the country this Saturday
en.summary: Tens of thousands of people marched in Madrid and other Spanish cities following parliament's rejection of housing protection measures proposed by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government.

stories.title: En Espagne, d’immenses manifestations pour le droit au logement à Madrid et dans de nombreuses villes

en.title: In Spain, massive demonstrations for the right to housing in Madrid and many cities
en.summary: A social movement emerged after an 87-year-old Madrid resident was evicted, becoming a symbol of Spain's worsening housing crisis over recent years.

stories.title: Nouvelles manifestations pour le droit au logement prévues samedi en Espagne

en.title: New demonstrations for the right to housing planned Saturday in Spain
en.summary: Further housing rights protests are scheduled for October 3 in Madrid and other Spanish cities after lawmakers rejected tenant protection bills from Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government.

stories.title: Le copilote du vol FlyDubai qui a agressé son commandant de bord planifiait un "acte terroriste", affirme le procureur général des Emirats arabes unis

en.title: FlyDubai copilot who assaulted captain was planning a "terrorist act", says UAE prosecutor general
en.summary: The prosecutor general of the United Arab Emirates has stated that the copilot involved in an assault on a FlyDubai flight was planning a terrorist act.

stories.title: Vol Flydubai : le copilote à l’origine de l’attaque planifiait un «acte terroriste» et était interdit de vol par les autorités d’Oman

en.title: FlyDubai flight: copilot behind attack was planning a "terrorist act" and was banned from flying by Omani authorities
en.summary: The UAE prosecutor general announced that the copilot was preparing a terrorist act. Omani authorities had previously banned him from flying after he reportedly became radicalized during time in Syria.

en.title: Brazil's presidential election: Lula's final battle
en.summary: Brazil's 80-year-old president seeks a fourth term against Flávio Bolsonaro. Despite a favorable record, he struggles to build support beyond his core supporters.

en.title: Sébastien Lecornu faces the high school crisis
en.summary: A high school crisis continues to expand with a planned mobilization day on October 6. The government confronts a movement lacking specific demands, complicated by urban riots.

stories.title: « J’ai totalement confiance en Jordan » : Marine Le Pen réaffirme son soutien à Bardella après le deuxième volet de l’enquête de Mediapart

en.title: "I have total confidence in Jordan": Marine Le Pen reaffirms support for Bardella after Mediapart investigation's second part
en.summary: A Mediapart investigation alleges the RN president wrote antisemitic messages in his youth, leaving him weakened after a tumultuous political season. Le Pen publicly backs him.
